comments.author: Lisa
comments.body: This is better than BTC for adventure and just as good for trading overall. Your BTCs are getting 4/4 which means they will never be the ship you think they are. Unless you're using Delphi. Tea clip starts with higher turn and WR, less studding sails to strip your turn rate and the ability to have a higher WR as well, which equals speed. The BTC is a huge turd that's basically a TLG with an outboard motor on the back. If you want speed go with the LMS or Tea Clipper, if you care about 'omgwtf' cargo space, keep your Brontisoarus Trade Clipper.

comments.author: Schipper
comments.body: Assuming both teaked and 22/25/-1 sails, BTC will have +44v/-23h sails compared to the Tea Clipper. While the Tea Clipper will have much higher turn and WR, the BTC is likely faster on a long trip in a straight line.
